title: D4 local-network baseline: single-ref vs per-chain on a disposable LAN bare remote
objective: Run the preregistered sweep on ubu nodes against a disposable local-network bare remote under both layouts; report every preregistered metric against the frozen bounds and the git-CAS operating envelope.
problem: The operator's standing hypothesis is that git compare-and-swap is an adequate transport at this scale; workgraph's single-ref claim plane is expected to thrash as workers grow. Neither is measured.
evidence_required: receipts for every attempt (from the remote's receipts slots)
a report with each metric vs its frozen bound, per arm and sweep point

acceptance.condition: the preregistered report is produced; each bound is reported PASS/FAIL as preregistered (layer-3 style: a failed bound is a valid result)

resource_ceiling: MWO-0004 R2: <=16 CPU core-hours per item, <=48 per seat per rolling 24 h; local, unpaid; ubu nodes shared with idle PrometheusWorkers
notes: measurement task; no red state applies.
